title: mespilus microphylla
intro: Mespilus microphylla, commonly known as Chinese hawthorn, is a shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including aiding digestion, lowering cholesterol levels, and helping to manage blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Mespilus microphylla include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardio-protective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
